pkgmetadata.longdescription: Fork of llama.cpp by Ivan Kawrakow with additional SOTA quantization types (IQK), fused MoE operations, MTP/self-speculative decoding and improved CPU and hybrid GPU/CPU inference performance. Installed under /opt/ik-llama-cpp with ik- prefixed symlinks in /usr/bin to coexist with sci-misc/llama-cpp.
